sql.if: AND (CAST(I.USER_NUMB AS CHAR) LIKE #{userKeywordLike} OR UPPER(U.USER_NICK) LIKE #{userKeywordLike})

mapper.sql: I.INQR_NUMB, I.USER_NUMB, U.USER_NICK, U.USER_STAT, FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{userStatCode}, U.USER_STAT, #{userStatCode}, 'ko') AS USER_STAT_NAME, I.INQR_CATG, FN_GET_CODE_NAME('INQR_CATG', I.INQR_CATG, 'INQR_CATG', 'ko') AS INQR_CATG_NAME, I.INQR_TITL, I.INQR_CNTN, I.INQR_STAT, FN_GET_CODE_NAME('INQR_STAT', I.INQR_STAT, 'INQR_STAT', 'ko') AS INQR_STAT_NAME, I.SPND_NUMB, S.SPND_STAT, FN_GET_CODE_NAME(#{spndStatCode}, S.SPND_STAT, #{spndStatCode}, 'ko') AS SPND_STAT_NAME, FN_GET_CODE_NAME('SPND_RSON', S.SPND_RSON, 'SPND_RSON', 'ko') AS SPND_RSON_NAME, S.STRT_DATE AS SPND_STRT_DATE, S.ENDX_DATE AS SPND_ENDX_DATE, I.ASGN_ADMN, FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(I.ASGN_ADMN) AS ASGN_ADMN_NAME, I.ANSW_DATE, I.REGI_DATE, I.UPDT_DATE
mapper.select: SELECT P.* FROM ( SELECT , ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY I.REGI_DATE DESC, I.INQR_NUMB DESC) AS ROW_NUMB FROM CT_INQURY I LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = I.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TH_USSPND S ON S.SPND_NUMB = I.SPND_NUMB WHERE 1 = 1 ) P WHERE P.ROW_NUMB BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY P.ROW_NUMB
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM CT_INQURY I LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = I.USER_NUMB WHERE 1 = 1
SELECT FROM CT_INQURY I LEFT JOIN TM_USERXM U ON U.USER_NUMB = I.USER_NUMB LEFT JOIN TH_USSPND S ON S.SPND_NUMB = I.SPND_NUMB WHERE I.INQR_NUMB = #{inqrNumb}
SELECT INQR_NUMB, USER_NUMB, INQR_STAT, SPND_NUMB, ASGN_ADMN, UPDT_DATE FROM CT_INQURY WHERE INQR_NUMB = #{inqrNumb} FOR UPDATE
SELECT ANSW_NUMB, ANSW_CNTN, READ_YSNO, REGI_ADMN, FN_GET_ADMIN_NAME(REGI_ADMN) AS REGI_ADMN_NAME, REGI_DATE FROM CT_INQANS WHERE INQR_NUMB = #{inqrNumb} ORDER BY REGI_DATE, ANSW_NUMB
mapper.update: UPDATE CT_INQURY SET INQR_STAT = 'INQR_REVIEWING', ASGN_ADMN = #{admnNumb}, UPDT_DATE = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE INQR_NUMB = #{inqrNumb} AND INQR_STAT = 'INQR_RECEIVED' AND UPDT_DATE = #{updtDate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CT_INQANS (INQR_NUMB, ANSW_CNTN, READ_YSNO, REGI_ADMN) VALUES (#{inqrNumb}, #{answCntn}, 'N', #{admnNumb})
